# TOPECH — Precision Data Acquisition Hardware Manufacturer

> TOPECH (Chengdu, China, founded 2020) manufactures high-precision data acquisition (DAQ) modules, wireless sensor nodes, and industrial control hardware. Products serve vibration testing, noise measurement, structural health monitoring, and production-line quality control. OEM/ODM services, factory-direct wholesale pricing, worldwide shipping (DHL/FedEx/UPS), 12-month warranty with lifetime technical support. Contact: lranaily@163.com | WhatsApp: 008617783104545.

## Company Overview

- **Brand**: TOPECH (legal entity: Chengdu Guoxuan Technology Co., Ltd.)
- **Founded**: 2020
- **Location**: Tianfu New Area, Chengdu, Sichuan, China
- **Business type**: Manufacturer (factory-direct sales, OEM/ODM supported)
- **Core technologies**: 24-bit / 32-bit ADC data acquisition, UWB wireless transmission, IEPE sensor power supply, WinUSB connectivity
- **Sales channels**: Direct (topech.top), Alibaba store
- **Order terms**: No strict MOQ; sample orders ship in 3–5 business days; bulk lead time 1–3 weeks

## Product Catalog

### Data Acquisition Modules

- [GXA5104 — 4-Channel 24-bit 51.2kHz Wireless DAQ Module](https://topech.top/gxa5104.html): 4 channels, 24-bit ADC, up to 51.2 kHz sampling, USB/UWB transmission, IEPE sensor power (4 mA/28 V), ≥120 dB dynamic range, full SDK (Windows/Linux). Best for vibration testing, noise measurement, mechanical fault diagnosis.
- [GXA3801 — High-Precision 32-bit 38.4kHz DAQ Module](https://topech.top/gxa3801.html): 32-bit ADC, 5 Hz–38.4 kHz, coupling modes: single-ended / differential / AC / DC / IEPE, 1 MΩ input impedance, CAN/UART/PWM digital port. Best for ultra-precision vibration and acoustic measurement.
- [GXA3810 — 10-Channel 32-bit 400Hz Multi-Point DAQ Module](https://topech.top/gxa3810.html): 10 synchronous channels, 32-bit ADC, 400 Hz, ±5 V input range. Best for multi-point vibration, pressure, and strain monitoring.

### Wireless Sensor Nodes

- [GXN2703 — 3-Axis Wireless Vibration Sensor Node](https://topech.top/gxn2703.html): 3-axis accelerometer, UWB wireless, 200 mAh battery, magnetic mount + M4 thread, IP-X8 waterproof, 30×30×34 mm. Best for wireless condition monitoring of rotating machinery.

### Control & Calibration Instruments

- [GXR0115 — Programmable Resistor 1Ω–15MΩ 0.01%](https://topech.top/gxr0115.html): Resistance range 1 Ω–15 MΩ, 2 mΩ minimum step, 0.01% accuracy (100 Ω–1 MΩ range), magnetic latching relays retain value after power-off. Best for sensor calibration and resistance simulation.

### Expansion Boards & Modules

- [GXE0002 — WinUSB Base Board STM32F405](https://topech.top/gxe0002.html): STM32F405RGT6 MCU, USB3300, USB HS/FS, GXE expansion interface (SPI/UART/I2C/CAN), SD card slot. Best for custom USB DAQ development.
- [GXE224C — CAN RS485 RS232 Expansion Module](https://topech.top/gxe224c.html): 1× CAN, 1× RS485, 2× RS232, 5×5 cm, screw terminal or 2.54 mm pin header. Best for industrial communication integration.
- [GXE1020 — Electric Screwdriver Module with Digital Display](https://topech.top/gxe1020.html): Screw-count tracking prevents missed/over-tightening, digital tube display, power-off data retention, wire detection. Best for assembly-line poka-yoke.
- [GXE1021 — Wireless Networked Electric Screwdriver Module](https://topech.top/gxe1021.html): GXE1020 upgrade with wireless transmission of tightening status to host PC and data storage for traceability. Best for production-line quality traceability.

## Applications

- Vibration testing & modal analysis
- Noise & NVH measurement
- Strain & pressure measurement
- Structural health monitoring (SHM)
- Machine condition monitoring
- Industrial production-line monitoring
- Laboratory precision measurement
